items.subject: Triage residual: yellow-bell-pepper Family Fare withheld on a self-contradicting read (from 2026-09-23-92e552)
evidence: flag-verification.json 2026-09-25 | yellow-bell-pepper|Family Fare | claim 'Yellow Bell Pepper' | '10 for $10.00 with purchase of 10' | 1 ea | $1.0000/each | sale 09-20..09-26 | status wrong-price, verdict_at 2026-09-22, claim has NO deal_qty | store read 09-22: $1.99, 1 ea, product_id:2310571

comparison-2026-09-22 FF cell carries no deal_qty (built 08:13, before 88c0b05dd stamped it at 14:39); comparison-2026-09-23 WITHHELD the cell ('no previously published value'), and its quarantine record carries only bad_item / bad_per_unit

flag-verify-lib Update-TcFlagLedger copied deal_qty only when the LIVE cell publishes the claim, so a withheld cell's disagreement could never be re-judged; Get-TcDealCondition('10 for $10.00 with purchase of 10') = qty 10, 'when you buy 10'
items.root_cause: not a capture defect and not a price change: the verifier judges a quantity deal by the engine's condition, but read it off the live cell only, and a quarantined cell's record did not carry it, so a verdict taken before the condition existed withheld the cell on every build while the ad kept producing the same claim

root_fix.what: the quarantine record carries the held candidate's deal condition and the ledger reads it for a held claim
root_fix.exact_change: Add-TcHeldDealCondition writes bad_deal_qty / bad_deal_condition onto withheld and last-good entries when the cell carries deal_qty; Get-TcBoardCellIndex exposes them as held_deal_qty / held_deal_condition; Update-TcFlagLedger copies them onto a claim whose claim_key equals the held_key

The quarantine record now carries it and the ledger re-judges a held claim with it (a match against the store's $1.99 single).
